name: js-player-module-brightcove
description: Brightcove custom player using the Brightcove Player API.
author: yama-dev

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: tsc --ignoreConfig src/utils/number.ts src/config.ts src/types.ts src/player/player-time.ts src/player/player-registry.ts src/player/player-controls.ts src/player/player-renderer.ts src/player/player-lifecycle.ts src/player/player-events.ts --target ES2020 --module commonjs --noImplicitAny false --outDir .tmp-test && node test/number.test.js && node test/config.test.js && node test/player-time.test.js && node test/player-registry.test.js && node test/player-controls.test.js && node test/player-renderer.test.js && node test/player-lifecycle.test.js && node test/player-events.test.js
scripts.test:release: npm run clean && npm run test && npm run prod && npm run test:bundle
scripts.release:check-versioned: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const dir='.changeset'; const pending=fs.existsSync(dir)?fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((file)=>file.endsWith('.md')):[]; if(pending.length){ console.error('Pending changesets: '+pending.join(', ')); console.error('Run npm run version-packages and commit the result before npm run release.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.release: npm run release:check-versioned && npm run test:release && npm run pack:check && changeset publish
